steps.title: 初始化參數
: 判斷tranType
steps.details:
如果（TranType="M_PAYEEEMAIL" 或 TranType="MMA_PAYEEEMAIL" 或 TranType="MMA_REMIT")
並且MEParameters.IndexOf("交易已受理") > -1))
bSendMail=true；

steps.title: 依交易區分PUSH提示（需要進行推播的組合參數進行推播）
不需要推播，只需要發送郵件的邏輯
steps.details:
1.如果(TranType == "M_PERFOREIGNCASH" || TranType == "MMA_PERFOREIGNCASH") bSendMail賦值為true
2.如果(TranType == "M_BANK_TFRIN" || TranType == "MMA_BANK_TFRIN") bSendMail賦值為true
3.如果(TranType == "FlexHouseLoan_Terminate" || TranType == "FlexHouseLoan_Apply")bSendMail賦值為true
4.如果 (TranType == "MMA_MORTORTGAGES" || TranType == "M_MORTORTGAGES")bSendMail賦值為true
5.如果 (TranType == "SecCheckError")bSendMail賦值為true
6.如果(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(TranType) && TranType.StartsWith("M_CARDLESS_"))bSendMail賦值為true

steps.title: 行動銀行、大戶APP財金繳費項目-繳費成功不需要發送郵件
steps.details:
1.如果((TranType == "M_PAYMENT_TPEWATER" || TranType == "M_PAYMENT_TELECOM" || TranType == "M_PAYMENT_OTHERBANKCREDIT")
&& DateTime.Now >= DateTime.ParseExact(ConfigurationManager.AppSettings["PaymentStartMailStopDate"], "yyyy/MM/dd", null))；bSendMail賦值為false

steps.title: B2C 交易寄信
發送郵件
steps.details:
1.定義newAcct變量，用於存放隱匿後賬號訊息
2.根據賬號格式隱匿賬號中間數字，對newAcct進行賦值
3.調用 MailQueue.AddMonitorMail(METemplateID, MEReferenceID, MESubject, MEContent, MEReceivers,MEParameters, MECreator, TranType);發送郵件
